2085-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2085-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2728-5686-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5686-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5686-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2760-6012.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2760-6012.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Nest of Scarabs and Reluctant Role Model.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
2760-6012.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

2104-5626-7874.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2104-5626-7874.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
2104-5626-7874.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning The Immortal Weapons from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing The Immortal Weapons, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-6791-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1818-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-4068.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3132-3259-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1368-3480-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7640.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

851-1558-2638-3756-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-2638-3756-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1912-4131-7329.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-4460-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2060-4929-5652-7267.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Michelangelo.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-4661--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vesuvan Doppelganger that has haste. Choose to have Vesuvan Doppelganger enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Vesuvan Doppelganger token instead.
618-4661--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Vesuvan Doppelganger's toughness.

773-1409-2499.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve both Galazeth Prismari triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3661-4053-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1085-4053-5231.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

93-723-4067.description:
Activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Progenitus and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Progenitus.
Progenitus triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Captain Sisay.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4499-5299.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn with {3} each extra turn
2724-3080-4499-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

1069-3228-3480-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-3480-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

586-944-2292-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1575-4231-5315.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1283-2816-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2816-4091.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2694-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2694-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Gavony Unhallowed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1486-1651-2056.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's -2 loyalty ability turning an artifact you control into an artifact creature copy of Magda.
Put the original Magda in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clock of Omens and Magda, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping a Treasure token and Magda, targeting Magda.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Activate Magda's last ability any number of times by sacrificing any number of Treasures.

2034-3537-3936-4417-5304.notablePrerequisites: The Eldest Reborn has two lore counters on it.
2034-3537-3936-4417-5304.description:
Sacrifice Core Prowler to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Proliferate the lore counter on The Eldest Reborn.
Target Core Prowler with the saga trigger.
In response to the saga trigger use Bog Initiate to turn one of the generic mana from Ashnod's Altar into {B} and activate Hex Parasite having x be 1 targeting Eldest Reborn lowering it to two lore counters.
Hex Parasite gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the saga trigger returning Core Prowler to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2026-2605-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-2605-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
